caption: The drawing shows a waterfront scene labeled "PORT OF BUFFALO ON LAKE ERIE" at the top. The composition is curved, almost like a stage backdrop or panoramic view, with a dominant blue color depicting water. In the upper center, there is a large white boat with red detailing and a green canopy, floating on the blue water. To the right and left of the boat are tall green trees with visible brown trunks and curved branches. At the bottom left, two human figures dressed in brown stand next to a striped fence or stair rail. Additional greenery, bushes, and tree clusters fill in the central and right areas by the water’s edge. There are two smaller boats in the water; a red rowboat near the center, and a small sailboat with a pink sail to the left. Another fenced area is visible at the lower right, containing a green patch of land. The drawing uses pale tan for the background outside the main scene, with details in greens, browns, reds, and blues throughout the composition. The artist’s signature appears on the lower right outside the curved frame.
title: Bandbox
